purpose: Replace loan-demo UAT-001..007 in UAT Template.docx with FrinStore business scenarios (minimum 5 required by PDF; 7 listed to mirror template density).

uat_cases.scenario_title: New customer registers and can log out and log back in
uat_cases.expected_business_result: Account created as customer; after login user sees storefront; after logout protected pages require login; no admin UI exposed.

uat_cases.scenario_title: Customer browses catalog, opens a product, and confirms price/stock display is usable
uat_cases.expected_business_result: Products load from API; detail view matches list item; navigation remains usable on mobile width.

uat_cases.scenario_title: Customer adds items, updates quantities, removes an item, completes checkout
uat_cases.expected_business_result: Cart totals update correctly; checkout requires auth; order created with FS- reference pattern; confirmation shows items and totals.

uat_cases.scenario_title: Customer views order history and sees status for a placed order
uat_cases.expected_business_result: Only that customer's orders appear; newest order visible with expected initial status.

uat_cases.scenario_title: Staff admin adds a new product, edits it, verifies it appears to customers
uat_cases.expected_business_result: Product persists; appears in catalog listing for customer session or after refresh.

uat_cases.scenario_title: Staff admin updates an order status and customer sees the update
uat_cases.expected_business_result: Status change saved; customer order view reflects updated status without exposing other customers' orders.

uat_cases.scenario_title: Guest and customer cannot access admin routes; admin cannot be treated as customer-only restricted endpoints incorrectly
uat_cases.expected_business_result: Router/guards block unauthorized areas; API returns 401/403 as applicable for protected actions.
